_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With institutional flows deteriorating against technical momentum and no clear directional catalyst, the coil resolves either way — but current evidence supports waiting rather than anticipating.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both call HOLD/Hope but analyst is far more cautious (0.35 vs 0.68 confidence), seeing distribution risk where Narrative sees coiling opportunity
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows reclaim 85+ and funding pushes above 70 with BTC holding above $75K — signals institutional re-engagement validating Optimism breakout
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $72K with VIX sustaining above 60 and funding dropping below 40 — confirms Hope was a lower-high in distribution, triggering descent to Anxiety/Complacency
